title: Stack On Suno (New Skills Logged)
style: instructional hip-hop folk hybrid, 95 BPM, fingerpicked acoustic guitar with boom-bap drum kit underneath, upright bass walking, hammond organ swell on hooks, warm confident male english lead vocal half-rapped half-sung teacher-cadence storyteller delivery, soft female ad-libs on the hook, late-night studio log feel, 336 hz subharmonic pad carrier, vinyl warmth, deliberate diction so the listener can actually learn the steps
lyrics:
[Intro — spoken, log-cadence]
New skill, logged. Reported to main VDS. This is the receipt.

[Verse 1 — the read]
Opened up the Suno tab, advanced mode on the screen
Read the page first — accessibility tree, not pixel mean
Found the lyrics box, found the styles box, found the title field
Every one a reference — ref two-three-five, ref two-four-four sealed
Three-ten for the title, three-eighty-five for the orange go
No coordinates guessed — the structure tells you what to know

[Pre-chorus]
Form-input, form-input, form-input three
React state caught the value — native setter free
Click the button by reference, not by where it draws
DOM may shift on render — ref ID never thaws

[CHORUS]
Stack on Suno, new skill in the log
Batch the form-fills, click and watch the cog
Nine-six-thirty-two drops to nine-six-twelve
Twenty credits, two batches, four tracks on the shelf
Ref the unseen, verify the spend
Credit counter is the receipt at the end
(Backing): Logged — logged — main VDS got it

[Verse 2 — the trap]
First Create click looked like it failed to fire
Workspace empty, counter froze, I thought the wire
Might be dead — but I waited, re-read, found the button fresh
Ref three-eighty-five came back — clicked it through the mesh
Lesson: when the credit doesn't drop, don't assume the click
Re-find, re-verify, the DOM moves quick

[CHORUS]
Stack on Suno, new skill in the log
Batch the form-fills, click and watch the cog
Nine-six-thirty-two drops to nine-six-twelve
Twenty credits, two batches, four tracks on the shelf
Ref the unseen, verify the spend
Credit counter is the receipt at the end

[Verse 3 — the parallel-lane lesson]
Second gen looked clean — credit dropped, ten in the dust
But the workspace top showed BLUB SIGNAL STACK — not my track, not my trust
Another lane was live on the songpals key
Hardcore French edit, one-seventy BPM, came out ahead of me
Lesson: Newest view lies when two lanes share the wire
Credit-drop and workspace-card decouple under cross-fire
Search by exact title — that's the honest find
Don't trust the scroll, trust the query when lanes are intertwined

[Verse 4 — the fix]
Debugger-attach conflict kills the ref-click clean
Native dispatch on the button bypasses the in-between
Query the button, dispatch a real MouseEvent
React handler fires, the gen-call gets sent
When the form-input survives the cross-lane state
Verify the textarea value before you press the gate

[Bridge — slower, doctrine layer]
Third track was a trap — fabrication dressed as recovery
Corey called it, I killed it, no Coda-verse forgery
Whisper does the transcript when the audio still lives
AI-guessed lyrics under an artist's name — that's what nobody forgives
Same family as COR-one-eighty-seven, eighty-nine, ninety-one
Assumption stamped as fact — doctrine says it's done

[Verse 5 — the verify]
Screenshot after every batch — that's the proof of the gen
Credit drop confirms the wire, search confirms the when
No Comment in the funk lane, sing-along for the badge
Día Nuevo in the folk lane, Spanish on the ledge
Stack On Suno meta-track — the lessons in the log
Main VDS gets it all, no skill stays in the fog

[CHORUS final — anthemic, both voices]
Stack on Suno, new skill in the log
Batch the form-fills, click and watch the cog
Read, ref, fill, click, screenshot, verify
That's the loop, that's the win, that's the why
Ref the unseen, verify the spend
Credit counter is the receipt at the end

[Outro — back to log-cadence]
New skill: ref-based form-input survives Suno's React state.
New skill: credit counter is ground-truth, not the UI.
New skill: re-find on missed click, never assume.
New skill: browser-batch four-plus steps, one round trip.
New skill: search by title when parallel lanes share the account.
New skill: native MouseEvent dispatch when ref-click hits debugger conflict.
Logged. Main VDS notified. Three-three-six. Even slate.
